justification: GST-2968: lib/review-depth.ts lets a round grant's bought round keep its fix round and changes the read-only PR_ROUND_CAP stop's offer to name the round grant at that head (the history now leaves read-only passes out of --prior-full when that grant applies, so the grant buys the round the stop names). Deterministic no-loss replay, no paid run: main (b79843c) against new nextStep over 21,233,664 History x depth cases (fullPasses 0-3, every last step, all 16 finding mixes, gate, adversarial-ran, lean, depth, range lines, pass-1 depth, owner grant, fix-checks, post-review, chained, prior-full unset and 0-4, round grant): 21,210,624 steps are identical (step-sequence sha256 2421776912a9f395d9fea8e7eb1b965562ac17eb04d3494001ae02c50ef81741 old, 20f82fdc2f7e84752b07926355f608a14eb9f4f0f768651bae424c4c1e8b66d2 new). The other 23,040 all have prior-full 2, a round grant, one full pass done and last=full, and move from stop (17,280) or the gate-class voices step that precedes that stop (5,760) to the granted round's fix round, a full (20,736) or scoped (2,304) pass: each adds a review pass and removes none, and a gate-class run still meets its voices at the next stop. Of the identical steps, 16,500,384 reasons are byte-identical and the other 4,710,240 differ only in the read-only stop's offer clause, inside the stop or the voices step that quotes it. No reader, depth, dispatch, brief, checklist or finding rule changes.
